steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I'm back.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: You alrightie, Ms. Silence?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I'm alright. In fact, perhaps I should thank you.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: What for?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Not much.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Alright. Well, then, shall we continue?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Where did you leave off?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Anthony offering Robin the olive branch.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: I was just talking with Ms. Mayer about how excellent his methods are.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I feel you may simply be overthinking it.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Perhaps he didn't think so hard about it at the time, wanting to give Robin his pure goodwill?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Hmm. Honestly, I can't deny that sort of possibility.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: But if he was just a simple, kindhearted person, he'd have no way of living through this world, Ms. Silence.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Forget it, I shouldn't be discussing this with you. Where did Mayer leave you?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Once Kafka and Anthony wrapped up talks, Anthony finally decided to break out.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: We got to Robin waking up in the clinic, and Anthony inviting her onto the jailbreak team.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: I have to say, Ms. Silence, I'm genuinely curious as to where you got this lead on Anthony from.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: From my mentor's things.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Hm? Really, Director Parvis got stuck into this too?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: No, it's been an age since I had any direct contact with him.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Moreover, I'm afraid he may not even know about this.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Ever since I left Rhine Lab, I've sorted through a great deal of intel I'd never once cared about before.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: And within that, I caught onto the Simons' tail.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: This family's destruction was very rapid. Moreover, some data were camouflaged very well, so to many people's eyes, it'd seem as though there was no change in the figures at all.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: But camouflage always tends to leave a trace. A statistical form here, a stray datum there. As long as you compare in detail, you'll find the problem that arises within.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I was only giving those figures a try at first, just to see, and never expected I'd come across anything like this.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: You only realized by chance... no, I guess it was inevitable.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: But why the sudden interest in sorting out all that data?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Because my trust in Rhine Lab, and my mentor, has started to wane.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: The 'Diαbolic Crisis?'

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: No, not just that.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: The 'Diαbolic Crisis' precipitated Saria's departure. What happened after that, I presume you understand even better than I do, Director Muelsyse.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: I see, now.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Wowie, I was just asking without thinking. Should you really have come out with all of this?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Isn't it what you wanted to hear?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I'm not good at covering things up, Director Muelsyse. So once I thought it through, I decided to be candid with you.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I may not be fond of my mentor at all, but he said something that stuck in my mind ever since—

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: What makes the schemers sweat is open talk.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Seems like I'm the villain here, huh.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: No. My time living at Rhodes Island has taught me one thing, and it's that not everyone who goes against you should be considered an enemy.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I believe that you're no villain... and neither is Saria.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: It is only that, you and I, and Saria, have no way to reach a mutual understanding.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Ahah. Maybe, yeah.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Director Muelsyse, do you still want to hear more?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Of course! We were just getting to the good part.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Aww, but the story's pretty much nearing the end here, isn't it?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: I mean, at that point, Anthony's whole jailbreak crew was more or less in place, right?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Anthony himself, Domma the mortician, Kafka, temp worker Mina.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Add in Robin, and everyone pulls together to kick ass and pull a prison break, right?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: No. Things aren't that simple.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Eh?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: No-one said Robin joined Anthony's team.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Eh?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: It's true that after that, Kafka, Domma and Anthony started working out how to pull off the jailbreak, and Robin was even included in it.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: But things were not that simple.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: What happened?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Do you still remember the helper you mentioned HydeBro sought out?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: I do. What about him?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: He found Robin.
